info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: svaBAvAdayam aSvaSabde vartate . ' avyakte Sabde ' iti DAtupAWe bahutra paWitam . lokaprayogAnusAreRa tezAM pratiniyatavizayatvaM boDyam . taTAhi - " kOkze kardati, pardate gudarave, rezeti vArke Bavet . bukkopi Svarave Bazeti hayaje hrezeti hezeti ca ' iti keSavasvAmI " iti mADavIye pratipAditam .

examples: 'tadyaTA Bihezate pipAsate kzipraM prayacCettAdfk tat' (E0 brA0 6.8). aBihezate'BihezamARAya (GAsArTaM) ABimuKyena SabdaM kurvARAya.
